rows.label: tlk43200142_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Are you keeping track of each
country's development level?

rows.label: tlk43200142_03_msg0002
rows.name:
When countries develop, there are
more jobs for the Merc Group.

rows.label: tlk43200142_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Some of those jobs should even
increase the stock in shops.

rows.label: tlk43200142_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Don't just focus on the jobs you have.
Keep contributing to each country in
mind too.

rows.label: tlk43200142_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Do your best to help them develop so
the Merc Group can grow.
